description: Security and privacy attestations the vendor publishes for this product (trust center, security page or certificate registry), as a sorted comma-separated set of codes, or none-published when the vendor's own trust/security page lists none. Only what the vendor states for the product or its hosted service; self-hosted open-source code with no hosted service is not-applicable. gdpr and ccpa mean the vendor states compliance (DPA offered), not a certification.
